_comment: Stills lifted from the company film to illustrate pages that had no
`depicts` is not decoration. A film still may only be attached to a page
when the shot genuinely shows that subject, and the rule that keeps this
honest is that a still is never captioned as a specific part — it shows a
facility, a machine, an operation, or people at work. Product photography
comes from the product pages, which carry verified attributions.
Every entry below was chosen by generating a contact sheet and looking at
it, not by guessing from a timecode.
25fps). It is deliberately outside the repository — it is 380 MB and must
not enter git. The film is letterboxed; crop=1920:824:0:128 removes the
bars, which cropdetect confirms is constant across the film.
